title: AGC Super-App Core Capabilities
content: AGC (All Good Connects) is an African super-messaging and social commerce platform featuring: Encrypted Chat, 24h Stories/Updates & Billboard Discovery, Marketplace Stores with Escrow Vault protection, Send My Bill (pay on behalf), In-chat Games (X/O, Whot!, and Ludo with optional Escrow Bets), Ajo/Esusu communal savings, Gokada/PickkR Dispatch, Artisan Hubs, Street Radio Audio Spaces, Town Communities, Healthcare, Legal, Job Board, and Scam Checker.

title: AGC Wallet, Escrow, Bills & Games
content: AGC does not support direct peer-to-peer Send Money transfers. Users transact safely via Escrow Trade Protection (marketplace & artisans), Send My Bill (requesting another AGC user to pay a utility, rent, school, medical, or custom bill on their behalf), Paystack wallet top-ups/withdrawals, Ajo contributions, Payroll, and in-chat X/O, Whot!, or Ludo matches (Friendly or Escrow Bet with 1% platform fee).
